title: Dangerous
text:
Dangerous. I bought the manual control version, which other than the knobs, is exactly the same as this one.

I'm sorry I wasted my money. I love the size, but mine doesn't broil properly and worse, the steel trim on the doors gets so hot that I got a second-degree burn the first time I used it. Would it have been so hard to use the same material for the trim that is used on the handles, which stay cool enough to touch? What makes this more dangerous is that you have to open the doors all the way to get them to stay open. If you are turning something in the oven and accidentally graze a doors, which will cause them both to slam shut, the trim will come squarely up against your arm - prepare for a relatively serious burn.

I am so disappointed. I could almost live with the danger of getting burnt, but the fact that still I have to use my full-size oven broiler to broil anything I want crispy on the top, negates part of the reason I like counter-top ovens. I wish I had used it before the 30 days were up. Now I will have to sell it on CL.

There’s no reason to turn up the heat with your conventional oven, as the Oster Digital French Door Oven cooks more efficiently, using up to 50 percent less energy. With 90 minute timer, your foods cook as long as you need, then the oven shuts off automatically. With a countertop oven this attractive, this efficient and this easy to use, you’ll enjoying using it for every meal you prepare.
